# Stonkhouse

> Public information about Stock Token options on Robinhood Chain. This is an information site; trades take place in the separate app, where current market availability and quotes are shown. Examples are labelled and are not live quotes.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://stonkhouse.fun/): buyer-first overview, payoff examples and live cards when available.
- [How it works](https://stonkhouse.fun/how-it-works): buying, writing, settlement and fees.
- [Risks](https://stonkhouse.fun/risks): option, oracle, issuer, contract and operational risks.
- [Legal](https://stonkhouse.fun/legal): availability and instrument facts.
- [Terms](https://stonkhouse.fun/terms) and [Privacy](https://stonkhouse.fun/privacy): current published notices.
- [Protocol documentation](https://docs.stonkhouse.fun/): detailed product and protocol reference.
- [Trading app](https://app.stonkhouse.fun/): live market data, wallet actions and account state.

## Source and interpretation

The site source is the `callhouse-site` repository. In it, `AGENTS.md` maps the code and release gates; `lib/site.ts` holds displayed status and launch examples; `lib/live.ts` validates read-only indexer data before showing it. Current fees, quotes, positions and contract addresses must be checked in the app, indexer and verified chain state. The site's example fee slip is not a live OrderBook fee read. No page here asks for a wallet.
